summary: First-finish smoke tests on wiwiksayur.com backend + frontend. Home, cart, auth (admin), admin dashboard, products, categories, store info, shipping quote (free & paid tiers), order create → mock Midtrans token → mock-pay, admin analytics, admin guard all working. CRITICAL BLOCKER: seeded loyalty & regular test users (setia@wiwiksayur.test, reguler@wiwiksayur.test) cannot login — Pydantic EmailStr rejects the .test TLD as reserved, so entire Pelanggan Setia badge / PRIORITY DELIVERY flow is untestable end-to-end via those seeded accounts.
passed: POST /api/auth/register creates new user + returns session_token; GET /api/auth/me returns is_pelanggan_setia field
POST /api/shipping/quote 100k @ 3.04km → fee=13000 (8000 base + 2500×2 beyond 2km), upgrade hint returned
POST /api/orders (flat body: items, lat, lng, address, recipient_name, recipient_phone) creates order, computes total incl. ongkir
POST /api/payments/midtrans/token returns {token: MOCK-..., mock:true} (mock mode as expected)
GET /api/admin/analytics as admin returns full schema
Admin guard: anonymous & customer both blocked from /api/admin/analytics
Frontend home: brand, 12 product-cards, 12 add buttons, cart badge increments to 1 on Tambah, cart drawer opens with subtotal
Frontend /auth: tab-login, google-login-btn, input fields, submit render
Admin login via UI succeeds, /admin route accessible for admin role, shows stat cards + orders list (WWK-2A993B7146 visible with QRIS paid status), inventory & analytics tabs present

failed.issue: POST /api/auth/login rejects setia@wiwiksayur.test and reguler@wiwiksayur.test with Pydantic EmailStr error: 'The part after the @-sign is a special-use or reserved name that cannot be used with email.' Both users are seeded in DB but unreachable, blocking Pelanggan Setia badge test, PRIORITY DELIVERY badge test, and reguler is_pelanggan_setia=false verification.
failed.evidence: curl POST /api/auth/login {email: 'setia@wiwiksayur.test'} → 422 value_error on body.email. Same for reguler@wiwiksayur.test.

failed.issue: Non-admin authenticated user hitting /api/admin/analytics returns 401 instead of expected 403 (spec asked for 403 for non-admin, 401 for anonymous).
failed.evidence: curl with valid customer bearer → status=401 (same as anonymous). Minor spec mismatch.

action_items: Fix seeded test-user emails: either (a) change seeded emails to a valid TLD like setia@wiwiksayur.example is ALSO reserved — use setia@wiwiksayur.co / setia@wiwiksayur.id, OR (b) relax email validation (replace EmailStr with a custom validator / use pydantic-settings EmailStr with allow_test_tlds, OR set email_validator's `check_deliverability=False` still won't help — reserved-TLD check is separate). Recommend switching seeded emails to a real-looking domain (e.g. @wiwiksayur.co.id) and updating /app/memory/test_credentials.md accordingly.
Optional: return 403 (not 401) for authenticated-but-non-admin requests on /api/admin/* to match spec.
Then re-test: setia login → /me is_pelanggan_setia=true, create order → is_priority=true, admin UI shows PRIORITY DELIVERY badge.
